description: Refused inputs of adversarial shape at the 8 MiB input ceiling, for the peak component linear memory qualification of policy-core-v3 (contracts/wit/policy-core-v3/SEMANTICS.md, sections 2 and 10). Each input is the concatenation of its segments, each text repeated count times. A component returns input-invalid and stays within memoryQualification.peakComponentLinearMemoryBytes of contracts/fixtures/policy-core-v2/resource-budgets.v1.json; the measurement itself is an implementation gate. defect is the class of the reference oracle, null when the decoder accepts the text and schema validation refuses it.
